Aiden Quinlan’s through ball created a vertical overload behind the defensive line, allowing Romano to capitalize on space and score a high-xG (0.745) chance from close range[#1881][#1882]. Seabrook Town’s dominance in the final 10 minutes—reflected in superior possession (55.5%), a 70.4% field tilt, and higher shot volume—demonstrated effective rest-defense transitions and pressing intensity that ultimately resulted in this decisive breakthrough.
